section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study examining the reliability and validity of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in 228 Black college women (M age = 19.89). The study investigated the relationship between ethnic identity and body appreciation, as well as convergent and divergent validity through associations with appearance evaluation, self-esteem, beauty ideal internalization, eating behaviors, and teasing. Results supported the construct validity of the BAS for use with Black college women.
